spans.s:
m. (-क्षः)
1 A destruction of the world.
2 A demon, a goblin.
3 The third incarnation of VIṢṆU, the Narasiṃha

Avatāra.
4

Lightning.
5

A field.
6 A peasant, a husbandman.
7 Loss, disappearance.
E.
क्षि or क्षै to waste, &c. affix क.

(म, ष) r. 1st cl. (क्षजते)
1 To go or approach.
2 To give.
(इ, ष, म) क्षजि r. 1st cl. (क्षञ्जते)
1 To go.
2 To give.
r. 1st and [] 10th cls. (इ) क्षजि (क्षञ्जति क्षञ्जयति)
To live in distress, to live in pain or want.

(उ) क्षणु r. 8th cl. (क्षणति क्षणुते)
To kill, to injure.

m. (-णः)
1 A measure of time, equal to thirty Kalās or four minutes.
2 A moment.
3 A festival.
4 Vacation from work, state of being unemployed.
5 Leisure, opportunity.
6 A certain day of the fortnight, as the full, change, &c. see पर्वन्.
7 Dependence, servitude.
8 The centre, the middle.
n. adv. (-णं)
For a moment.
E.
क्षण to injure, affix अच्.

m. (-पः)
A short delay.
E.
क्षण, and क्षेप throwing (away).

m. (-तुः)
A wound or sore.
E.
क्षण to hurt, अतु aff.

m. (-दः)
An astrologer.
n. (-दं)
Water.
f. (-दा)
1

Night.
2

Turmeric.
E.
क्षण leisure, a moment, &c. and द who gives.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Nocturnal, nightwalker.
mf. (-रः-री)
A fiend, a goblin.
E.
क्षणदा night, and चर who or what goes.

n. (-न्ध्यं)
Night blindness, nyctalopsis.
E.
क्षणदा, and आन्ध्य blindness.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Momentarily visible, seen for an instant.
E.
क्षण, and दृष्ट seen.

f. (-तिः)
Lightning.
E.
क्षंण, and द्युति light.

n. (-नं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
क्षण to hurt, to kill, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-सः)
A porpoise, the Gangetic porpoise.
E.
क्षण a moment, and निश्वास breath, breathing.

f. (-शः)
Lightning.
E.
क्षण, and प्रकाश manifest.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Gleaming, flashing.
f. (-भा)
Lightning.
E.
क्षण a moment, and प्रभा light.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Transient, frail, perishable.
E.
क्षण, and भङ्गुर breaking.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Momentary, short-lived.
E.
क्षण, and भूत been.

adv. n. (-त्रं)
Momentary, but for a moment.
E.
क्षण, and मात्र only.

m. (-मी)
A pigeon.
E.
क्षण a moment, and रम to play, affix णिनि.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Transient, frail.
E.
क्षण, and विध्वंसिन् what is destroyed.

adv. n. (-रं)
A minute afterwards, the next moment.
E.
क्षण, and अन्तर interval.

mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं)
Momentary, transient.
f. (-का)
Lightning.
E.
क्षण a moment, affix कन् or ठक्.

mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि)
Momentary, transient.
f. (-णी)
Night.
E.
क्षण, इनि and ङीप् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Hit, hurt, wounded, &c.
2 Broken, torn, rent.
3 Trodden or broken down.
4 Impaired, diminished.
5 Destroyed.
n. (-तं)
A wound, a sore, a hurt.
E.
क्षण to hurt, affix क्त, deriv. irr.

m. (-घ्नः)
The name of a plant, (Conyza lacera.)
f. (-घ्नी)
Lac, the animal dye.
E.
क्षत a wound, and घ्न what destroys or removes; from हन to kill, affix टक्, fem. affix ङीप्.

Blood.
2

Pus, matter.
E.
क्षत a wound, and ज produced.

mfn. (-जः-जाः-जं)
Dimmed, obscured, (as light or power.)
E.
क्षत, and तेजस् splendour.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Mangled, wounded.
E.
क्षत, and विक्षत wounded.

m. (-सी)
A sort of potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus): see ष्टद्धदार.
E.
क्षत a wound, &c. ध्वंसि to attack, with वि prefix, and णिनि aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
Destitution, being without the means of support, living on what one can get.
E.
क्षत, and वृत्ति maintenance.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
A violator of a vow or religious engagement.
E.
क्षत broken, and व्रत a religious obligation.

n. (-रं)
Agallochum or aloe wood: see अगुरु.
E.
क्षत a wound, and हर what removes.

mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि)
Victorious, triumphant.
E.
क्षत struck, and अरि a foe.

f. (-तिः)
A wound.
E.
क्षण to hurt, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः)
Weakened, reduced, impaired.
E.
क्षत, and ओजस् strength.

mfn. (-त्ता-त्त्री-त्तृ)
Occupied, engaged in work.
m. (-त्ता)
1 A charioteer, a coachman.
2 A doorkeeper, a porter.
3 The son of a Śūdra by a Kṣatriya woman, whose employment is catching animals that live in holes.
4 The son of a female slave.
5 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
6

The son of a Śūdra man and Vaiśya woman.
E.
क्षद a Sautra root, to screen or defend, to join or mix, Uṇādi affix तृच्.

m. (-त्त्रः)
A man of the second or military and regal class.
n. (-त्त्रं)
The body.
E.
क्षद Sautra root, to divide or eat, Uṇādi affix त्र; this word and its derivatives are commonly, for the sake of convenience, written with one त, क्षत्र.

mfn. (-त्त्रः-त्त्री-त्त्रं)
Belonging or relating to the military tribe.
E.
क्षत्र, and अण् aff.

m. (-र्म्मः)
The duty of a Kṣatriya, bravery, military conduct.
E.
क्षत्त्र, and धर्म्म duty.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Following or observing the duty of a soldier.
E.
क्षत्त्रधर्म्म, and अनुग who follows.

mfn. (-न्धुः-न्धू or न्धुः-न्धु)
1 A mere Kṣatriya, a certain Kṣatriya.
2 A Kṣatriya, one of the military tribe: see ब्रह्मबन्धु.

m. (-त्त्री)
A man of the military class.
E.
क्षत्र, and इनि aff.

mf. (-यः-या or -याणी)
A man or woman of the second or military tribe.
f. (-यी)
The wife of a Kṣatriya.
E.
क्षत्त्र, affix घ, fem. टाप् or ङीष्, in one form, with आनुक inserted.

f. (-तिः)
The military tribe or caste.
E.
क्षत्त्रिय, and जाति caste.

m. (-र्म्मः)
The duty or occupation of the warrior tribe, war, government, &c.
E.
क्षत्त्रिय, and धर्म्म duty.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Full of or abounding with the military tribe.
E.
क्षत्रिय, and प्राय most.

Sautra r. 1st cl. (क्षदति)
1 To eat.
2 To pull to pieces, to divide.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्)
1

Eating.
2

Dividing, tearing.
E.
क्षद to eat, &c., शतृ aff.

Eating.
2

Tearing, dividing.
E.
क्षद to eat, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be endured, to be suffered or submitted to patiently.
E.
क्षम to bear, and तव्य aff.

mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
Patient, resigned.
E.
क्षम to bear, to be patient, तृच् aff.

r. 10th cl. (क्षपयति)
1 To send, to throw, to cast, to direct, &c.
2 To bear patiently.
(इ) क्षपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (क्षम्पति क्षम्पयति)
1 To bear patiently, to endure.
3 To compassionate.
3 To shine.

f. (-पा)
Night.
E.
क्षप to send or reject, अ affix, and टाप् fem. do.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Shameless, impudent.
n. (-णं)
Defilement, impurity.
E.
क्षप to throw away (shame,) affix ल्युट्.

Buddha.
2

A Bauddha mendicant.
3 A Jaina mendicant.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-णी)
1 An oar.
2 A net: see क्षेपणि.

m. (-ण्युः)
Offence, transgression.
E.
क्षप to bear, अण्यु aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Bearing patiently, enduring.
2 Casting, sending.
E.
क्षप to send, शतृ aff.

m. (-रः)
The moon.
E.
क्षपा night, and कर who makes.

m. (-नः)
A dark cloud or clouds of night.
E.
क्षपा, and घन a cloud.

m. (-रः)
A fiend, a goblin.
E.
क्षपा, and चर who goes.

m. (-टः)
A Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin.
E.
क्षपा night, and अट who goes.

m. (-थः)
The moon.
E.
क्षपा, and नाथ lord.

m. (-न्तः)
Dawn, day-break.
E.
क्षपा, and अन्त end.

n. (-हं)
A day and night.
E.
क्षपा, and अहन् a day.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Submitted to, borne, endured.
2 Sent, cast, directed.
E.
क्षप, and क्त aff.

(उ, ष, ञि) ञिक्षमुष r. 1st cl. (क्षमते)
To bear or endure.
(उ, इर, भ) इरक्षमुभ r. 4th cl. (क्षम्यति)
To bear or endure.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Patient, resigned, enduring.
2 Refraining from, forbearing.
2 Able, adequate.
4 Benevolent, friendly.
5 Fit, appropriate, suitable, proper.
f. (-मा)
1

Patience.
2

The earth.
3

Night.
4

A name of DURGĀ.
n. (-मं)
Propriety, fitness.
E.
क्षम as above, affix अच्.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Slender, slim, emaciated.
2 Weak, infirm.
E.
क्षै to waste, affix क्त, form irr.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Patient, enduring.
2 Forgiving.
E.
क्षमा, and अन्वित possessed of.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Patient, forbearing.
E.
क्षमा, पर practising.

mfn. (-क्)
Patient.
m. (-क)
A king, a prince.
E.
क्षमा, the earth, &c. and भुज् who possesses.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Patient, enduring.
E.
क्षमा, and युक्त joined with.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Patient, enduring.
E.
क्षमा, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Patient, enduring.
E.
क्षम to bear, affix तृच्.

Patient.
2

Capable, able.
E.
क्षम to bear, घिनुण् aff.

m. (-यः)
1 Loss, waste, destruction, removal, &c.
2 A destruction of the universe.
3 Consumption, Phthisis pulmonalis.
4 A house, an abode.
5 Sickness in general.
6 Decay, wasting away.
7 In algebra, negative quantity, minus.
E.
क्षि to waste or destroy, affix अच्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Destroying, terminating.
2 Liberating from existence.
E.
क्षय, and कर who makes.

m. (-लः)
The end of all things, the period of destruction.
E.
क्षय, and काल time.

m. (-सः)
A consumptive or phthisical cough.
E.
क्षय, and कास cough.

m. (-थुः)
Cough, consumption.
E.
क्षि to waste, अथुच् affix; some copies read this क्षवथु, q. v.

f. (-नी)
A plant, (Celtis Orientalis): see जीवन्ती.
E.
क्षय consumption, and नाशिनी what removes.

m. (-क्षः)
The dark fortnight, that of the moon's wane.
E.
क्षय, and पक्ष half month.

m. (-युः)
The wind that is to blow at the end of the world.
E.
क्षय, and वायु wind.

f. (-क्तिः)
Necessity or opportunity of destroying.
E.
क्षय, and युक्ति fitness; also क्षययोग.

m. (-गः)
Consumption.
E.
क्षय, and रोग disease.

n. (-त्वं)
Consumption.
E.
क्षयरोगिन्, and त्व affix; also with तल् क्षयरोगिता.

mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि)
Consumptive, hectic.
E.
क्षय, and रोगिन् diseased.

f. (-त् or -द्)
Total loss, ruin, destruction.
E.
क्षय, and सम्पद् increase.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Wasting, decaying.
2 Consumptive.
E.
क्षय, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Wasting, decaying, perishing.
E.
क्षि to perish, इष्णुच् aff.

r. 1st cl. (क्षरति)
1 To drop or let fall.
2 To distil, to ooze, to trickle.
With सं,
To flow.
With आ,
r. of the 10th cl. (आक्षारयति)
To accuse, to abuse.

m. (-रः)
1 A cloud.
2 Trickling, oozing.
n. (-रं)
Water.
E.
क्षर to drop, and अच् aff.

Glass.
2

Juice, essence.
3 Molasses, treacle.
4

Salt.
5

Ashes.
6

A rogue, a cheat.
7 Borax, borate of soda.
8 Alkali, either soda or potash.
9 Caustic alkali, one species of cautery.
n. (-रं)
A factitious or medicinal salt, commonly black salt: see कृष्णलवण.
E.
क्षर to drop, or distil, affix अण्.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced by distillation, &c.
E.
क्षर, and ज born; also क्षरेज.

n. (-णं)
1 Trickling, running.
2 Distilling, dropping.
E.
क्षर, and ल्युट् aff.

nf. (-णं-णः)
Accusing, calumniating.
n. (-णं)
1

Distilling.
2

Converting to alkali or ashes.
E.
क्षार to drop, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
Trickling, oozing, running.
E.
क्षर to trickle, शतृ aff.

f. (-त्रा)
The Droṇapuṣpa plant.

n. (-त्रं)
A potherb, (Chenopodium album.)
E.
क्षार juice, and पत्र a leaf; also क्षारपत्रक.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Mutable, dissoluble.
E.
क्षर flowing, भाव property.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Oozed, trickling, dropped, flowing, liquefied.
E.
क्षर, and क्त aff.

Guilty.
2

Calumniated, falsely accused, specially of adultery.
3 Accused of crime.
4 Distilled from saline matter, strained through alkaline ashes, &c.
E.
क्षर to go or fall, in the causal form, affix क्त.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Dropping, flowing, trickling.
m. (-री)
The rainy season.
E.
क्षर water, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced by distilling, &c.
E.
क्षर in the seventh case, and ज born.

r. 1st cl. (क्षलति)
1 To shake.
2 To move, (some consider this as interchangeable with क्षर.)
r. 10th cl. (क्षलयति)
To purify, to cleanse or make clean.

Sneezing.
2

Cough, catarrh.
3 A species of Mustard, (Sinapis dichotoma, Rox.)
E.
क्षु to sneeze, affix अप्.

mfn. (-त्)
Sneezing, coughing.
E.
क्षव, and कृत who makes.

f. (-का)
1 A kind of rice.
2 A woman.

m. (-थुः)
1 Cough, catarrh.
2

Sneezing.
3

Irritation of the throat, sore throat.
E.
क्षु to sneeze, &c. अथुच् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Patient, enduring.
E.
क्षम to bear, affix क्त.

f. (-न्तिः)
Patience, forbearance, endurance.
E.
क्षम to be patient, affix क्तिन्.

mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु)
Patient, enduring.
E.
क्षम to bear, Uṇādi affix तुन्; the vowel is made long.

Slenderness.
2

Thinness, emaciation.
3 Debility.
E.
क्षाम, and तल् affix: also with त्व, क्षामत्व.

n. (-स्यं)
Improper regimen, diet, &c. Contra-indicated in disease.
E.
क्षाम debilitating, and आस्य to be eaten.

m. (-कः)
1 A blossom, a new blown flower.
2 A cage or basket for birds or fish.
3 A washerman.
4 Juice, essence.
E.
क्षर to fall or drop, affix ण्वुल्.

n. (-र्म्म)
Applying caustic alkali (lapis infernalis) to proud flesh, &c.
E.
क्षार, and कर्म्मन् act.

f. (-ला)
A potherb.

m. (-द्रुः)
A tree, commonly Ghantaparali: see घण्टापाटलि; also क्षारवृक्ष.

m. (-ध्यः)
A shrub, (Achyranthes aspera); also अपामार्ग.
E.
क्षार alkali, and मध्य middle; its alkaline ashes make it useful in washing clothes.

f. (-का)
Saline soil, especially an impure sulphate of soda.
E.
क्षार, salt, and मृत्तिका earth.

m. (-सः)
A salt or alkaline flavour.
E.
क्षार, and रस flavour.

m. (-क्षः)
Any tree yielding abundant potash, as the plantain, &c.
E.
क्षार, and वृक्ष a tree.

n. (-ट्कं)
Six kinds of trees distinguished by their juice, as the Butea frondosa, Grislea tomentosa, Achyranthes aspera, Cowach, Ghaṇṭāpārali, Coraya.
E.
क्षार, and षट्क six.

n. (-च्छं)
Sea-salt.
E.
क्षार salt, and अच्छ clear, pure.

f. (-का)
Hunger.

n. (-नं)
Washing, sprinkling, cleaning with water.
E.
क्षाल to wash, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be washed, to be cleaned with water.
E.
क्षल, and अनीयर् affix; also with तव्य and यत्, क्षालितव्य and क्षाल्य.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Washing, sprinkling.
E.
क्षल् to wash, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cleared, cleaned, washed.
E.
क्षाल to cleanse, affix क्त.
